snippet.title: How To Date A Magical Girl! 「August Trailer」Dating Sim
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/881560 - Original theme:「A Ghost In Your Dream」composed and performed by Tim Yatras, with vocals by Nadia Vanek. Recorded at Equinoxe Studios. Lyrics:

My shoes are scuffed
And my skirt is torn
And although I am bruised and sore
My face lights up when you're at my door

You take my trembling hand
And flash that smile again
We will face the day together
And though our hearts are tied
By the thread of fate
You'll leave me crying and broken

The jam on my toast
It doesn't taste as sweet
And the birds singing
Do not sound complete

The time will come
You will forget about me
And carry on your day
Was I ever real?

I finished trying to stand on my own
I'd give up all that I have to hold you

We could find our... 
How can it be...
I'm a ghost from your dream
